name: Hossein Margani
title: Senior Platform Engineer · Azure · Infrastructure as Code
summary: Senior Platform Engineer with 20 years in software engineering, the last 8 in DevOps and platform engineering, building and running secure cloud platforms on Azure. employment.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: One of two DevOps engineers (with the team lead) supporting two development teams of about 10 engineers each; also support and contribute to the company-wide DevOps Guild.
Operate AKS clusters for dev and production, multi-region and spread over availability zones for resilience. Run monthly AKS upgrades and patch Windows VM images and Windows/Linux Docker images.
Cut deployment time by 25% (from 12 to about 9 minutes) since joining, for a multi-region deployment that runs repeatedly for dev and monthly for production.
Implemented multiple infrastructure projects for the development teams in Pulumi (C#), modernising existing cloud environments with clean, reproducible configuration.
Planned and executed the migration from Packer to Azure Image Builder for VM images, improving consistency, automation and build quality.
Maintain pipeline templates and PowerShell scripts, document infrastructure usage for developers, handle client-raised tickets and take part in the on-call rotation.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Led two DevOps teams, setting technical direction and architecture and promoting best practices across all projects.
Designed and delivered secure, scalable Azure infrastructure aligned with development and business needs.
Embedded DevSecOps by adding security controls to CI/CD pipelines and enforcing infrastructure security standards.
Improved DevOps workflows through automation, new tooling and refined CI/CD pipelines for reliability and performance.
Mentored engineers and ran cross-team knowledge sharing.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
description: Designed ARM/Bicep templates and automated CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines (YAML) for multiple environments.

Delivered CI/CD for about 40 microservices plus several standalone projects: Octopus Deploy while on-premises, Azure Pipelines for the roughly 20 newer C# Azure Functions services, and TeamCity for building the legacy ones.
Migrated all repositories from Bitbucket to GitHub, and moved Service Bus, Redis and several applications from on-premises to Azure.
Managed AKS clusters, deployed with Helm v3 charts, and automated cluster patching and version upgrades.
Automated test environment provisioning with Chef, Vagrant, Azure Pipelines and Octopus Deploy.
Built dashboards and runbooks to visualise pipeline health and speed up operational tasks.
Implemented secure networking patterns: private endpoints, WAF policies and SQL vulnerability assessments.
